teach.heading: Numbers are made of parts
teach.body: Every three-digit number is made of hundreds, tens and ones. The number 346 has 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones.

teach.heading: Place value
teach.body: The place a digit sits in tells you how much it is worth. In 346 the 3 is in the hundreds place so it is worth 300. The 4 is in the tens place so it is worth 40. The 6 is in the ones place so it is worth 6.

teach.heading: Show it with blocks
teach.body: A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a small cube is 1. The number 346 is 3 flats, 4 longs and 6 cubes. Ten cubes make one long, and ten longs make one flat.

teach.heading: Reading and writing numbers
teach.body: We read 346 as three hundred and forty-six. The word 'and' comes after the hundreds. We write the digits in order: hundreds, then tens, then ones.

worked_examples.q: Write 5 hundreds, 2 tens and 8 ones as a number.
worked_examples.steps: Put 5 in the hundreds place, 2 in the tens place and 8 in the ones place.

worked_examples.q: What is the value of the 7 in 372?
worked_examples.steps: Find the place of the 7. It is the middle digit, so it is in the tens place.

worked_examples.q: How many hundreds, tens and ones are in 614?
worked_examples.steps: Read each digit by its place: 6, 1, 4.

guided_practice.q: How many hundreds, tens and ones are in 258?
guided_practice.hint: Say the place of each digit.

guided_practice.q: Write the number: 7 hundreds, 3 tens, 1 one.
What is the value of the 8 in 184?

guided_practice.hint: Say the hundreds, then 'and', then the rest.
